description: Free. Returns an UNSIGNED base64 transaction for the taker wallet to sign. Advan never signs and never holds keys. Default (selfBroadcast false) keeps JupiterZ routes, which need Jupiter POST /swap/v2/execute to add the market-maker co-signature. Pass selfBroadcast true to exclude jupiterz so the taker can broadcast the signed transaction.
name: build_swap_tx
title: Build unsigned swap transaction
